A2c_source_site_gallery_mined.rationale: Specialistroofing.com homepage has 5 candidate images. 2 of 5 are face-present jobsite shots saved as team-crew-on-roof.webp + team-roofer-nailing-shingles.webp. Neither is name-tagged so neither qualifies as owner photo via this path — they're medium-confidence team-harvest for the mini-card Tier 3-4 fallback chain. Other 3 candidates are: branded truck (research-assets owns this), phone mockup (logo only), and CGI house render (no people).

A3_firecrawl_serp_owner_brand.rationale: Used to discover owner identity (Andre + Chris Afsharian) since neither homepage nor sitemap reveals it. BBB business profile, Roofing Contractor magazine rebrand article, Prospeo, BuildZoom, Directorii, Yahoo Finance + the California LLC public-filing PDFs (Valley News group) ALL corroborate. Headshots themselves came from Path A1 legacy domain (higher resolution) — the SERP corroborated the identification.

A4_manual_operator_upload.rationale: A1 + A3 produced high-confidence owner photo. Tier 5 AI-generated likeness fallback NOT required.
